main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: re ne graventur, si fortè de nonnul- lis præmoneri hinc quiverint. Cum enim perlongo tempore hanc ar- tem sectatus fuerim, nec tantum perpetuis cogitationibus & studio theoretico, multorûq; manuscrip- torum inspectione, quorum men- tio passim à nobis fit, sed manuali insuper labore, & experientiâ pro- priâ, quæ (ut proverbio dicitur) vel stultorum est magistra, non sine gra vi intertrimento & attentaverim, & compererim plurima, licebit mi hi spero, aliqua ex parte hujus rei conditionem & fundamentum studiosis Chymiæ paulo altius re- tegere & de me gustum aliquem præbere, quousq; vel cogitando vel studendo vel conando operan- dove pertigerim. page.notes: The first line reads "re ne graventur" (the start of "ne graventur" run on from the heading area); the text is set in a woodcut border on all four sides, which is not transcribed. Words such as "Quamvis" and "omni-" are at the column end and the rest of the word continues on the next page. Some words are slightly blurred in the scan (e.g. "compererim", "gustum"), but read as printed.
